The purpose of this procedure is to describe the
 steps which must be followed to put this fire protection system back into
 service after a fire fighting incident.

items:
A work permit must be issued 
 and the qualified maintenance staff should be carry the
 Suitable safety category,

Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear your safety 
 and healthy equipments safety helmet, safety shoes
 . etc
Safety Helmet, Safety Shoes.
Unscrew the plugs on the overflow outlet pipe.

Open the valve in the supply line from the reserve
 water supply.

Start filling the tank with water until water comes
 out of the overflow pipe.

Close the valve in the reserve supply line and screw
 on the plug on the overflow pipe.

To
 reset the trigger mechanism, lift the lever on the right side of the trigger
 until it engages, an audible clicking noise can be heard. If the system was
 activated manually through the emergency station, you must also reset the
 mechanical lever by pulling the steel cable. This will also reset the pull
 handle in the emergency pull-station, the glass must also be replaced.

Move the saw-toothed slide so that the releasing
 mechanism is in its initial position.

Set the locking pins on the valve heads so the
 opening levers on the cylinders are in the closed position.

Remove the connecting pin of the tie-rod on the saw
 toothed slide.

Now you are able to remove the discharge device on
 the cylinders by loosening the screws
located around the base of the valve heads.

Disconnect the connection hose between the outlet of
 the cylinder valves and the C02 manifold.

Carefully move the cylinders out and remove the
 holding bracket connected to the cylinder weighing
 device.

Screw
 the valve caps onto the cylinder valves and move the cylinders out to be
 recharged

Remove
 the transport caps from the cylinder valves.

Install
 the weighing bracket and secure the cylinders into the bracket.

Screw
 on the connection hose between the cylinder valves and the C02 manifold.

Install
 the cylinder valve opening device. Make sure the lever is aligned with the
 slot in the valve head so it can move
 to the horizontal position when required.

Insert the connecting pin of the tie-rods and the
 saw-toothed slide, ensure that the whole assembly is free to move.

Remove
 the safety pins to release the manual valve heads. Be sure that all systems
 are in working order and the detection system is switched
 back to the ON position (to prevent accidental gas discharge ).

Reset
 the electrical discharge trigger switch manually by pressing down the button
 provided at the base of this contact
 switch.

text:
Introduction
The purpose of this procedure is to describe the
 steps which must be followed to put this fire protection system back into
 service after a fire fighting incident.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued 
 and the qualified maintenance staff should be carry the
 Suitable safety category,
Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear your safety 
 and healthy equipments safety helmet, safety shoes
 . etc
Tools and Equipment
Safety Helmet, Safety Shoes.
Work to be carried out
Filling
the Water Tank
Unscrew the plugs on the overflow outlet pipe.
Open the valve in the supply line from the reserve
 water supply.
Start filling the tank with water until water comes
 out of the overflow pipe.
Close the valve in the reserve supply line and screw
 on the plug on the overflow pipe.
Removing the
Discharged C02 
Cylinders
To
 reset the trigger mechanism, lift the lever on the right side of the trigger
 until it engages, an audible clicking noise can be heard. If the system was
 activated manually through the emergency station, you must also reset the
 mechanical lever by pulling the steel cable. This will also reset the pull
 handle in the emergency pull-station, the glass must also be replaced.
Move the saw-toothed slide so that the releasing
 mechanism is in its initial position.
Set the locking pins on the valve heads so the
 opening levers on the cylinders are in the closed position.
Remove the connecting pin of the tie-rod on the saw
 toothed slide.
Now you are able to remove the discharge device on
 the cylinders by loosening the screws
located around the base of the valve heads.
Disconnect the connection hose between the outlet of
 the cylinder valves and the C02 manifold.
Carefully move the cylinders out and remove the
 holding bracket connected to the cylinder weighing
 device.
Screw
 the valve caps onto the cylinder valves and move the cylinders out to be
 recharged
Installing new (recharged) C02 
Cylinders:
Remove
 the transport caps from the cylinder valves.
Install
 the weighing bracket and secure the cylinders into the bracket.
Screw
 on the connection hose between the cylinder valves and the C02 manifold.
Install
 the cylinder valve opening device. Make sure the lever is aligned with the
 slot in the valve head so it can move
 to the horizontal position when required.
Insert the connecting pin of the tie-rods and the
 saw-toothed slide, ensure that the whole assembly is free to move.
Remove
 the safety pins to release the manual valve heads. Be sure that all systems
 are in working order and the detection system is switched
 back to the ON position (to prevent accidental gas discharge ).
Reset
 the electrical discharge trigger switch manually by pressing down the button
 provided at the base of this contact
 switch.
